observation.command:
cd /workspace && for port in 8082 8081 8080 8100 8101 8102; do
  code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 8 http://localhost:$port/ 2>/dev/null)
  echo "port $port -> HTTP $code"
done
